P_calibration.quote: 1 U.S.C. § 1 defines "person" broadly, so the general "any person" in Sec. 3(a) reaches more than the narrow "U.S. person" definition.

P_grandfather_step.quote: The delay gives operators time to start or expand operations, line up the exemptions, or restructure to avoid the "U.S. person" definition before the ban takes effect.
